text.abstract: Split the shared `.yolo-twice/project.json` state as the merge-conflict analysis proposed: `project.json` and `source.json` moved out of the committed tree into `cache/`, each session gets a committed `meta.json` that feeds the project list, live-tail summaries go to `cache/text/`, and the attention slider moved to a gitignored `local.json`, with an automatic migration of the old layout and 50 passing tests. This was needed because every engine rewrote the same aggregate file each turn, so teammates indexing in parallel produced merge conflicts, and because `ClaudeCliSummarizer` passed `--bare`, which skipped login and made every summary call fail. Outcome: commits 582ef0e, f46f357, 4073b3f and 6245e42 landed, the `--bare` flag was replaced with `--settings '{"disableAllHooks": true}'`, and real Claude summaries now return in about 6 seconds, with titles limited to one line.
text.title: Built yolo-twice scaffold, linked views, follow mode, portable paths, split layout
